meta.title: The Signal Beneath the Ice
meta.subtitle: A mystrerious signal begins broadcasting from beneath an abandoned Arctic research station. You arrive to investigate — but something below the ice is awake.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 📡 The Distress Signal
scenes.narrative:
A harsh wind cuts across the frozen Arctic plain as your snowmobile sputters to a stop outside Outpost Aurora, a research station abandoned five years ago.

Three nights ago, a signal began broadcasting from this location — a repeating pulse that no satellite or radio system can identify.

The main building stands dark.
A faint light flickers from the communications tower.

And beneath your boots, the ice vibrates... ever so slightly.

You are the first person to arrive.

Something here is still active.

choices.text: Scan the ice with your equipment.

scenes.title: 🔬 The Abandoned Laboratory
scenes.narrative:
The station door groans as you push it open.

Inside, the power is partially restored. Emergency lights glow red across overturned desks and scattered research notes.

A frozen coffee cup sits beside a terminal that still hums softly.

One message loops on the screen:

"It wasn't buried, it was waiting."

At the back of the room is a sealed elevator leading down into the ice.

You hear a faint metallic scratching sound from below.

choices.text: Use the terminal to read the research logs.
Take the elevator down into the ice chamber.
Leave the station and investigate the tower.

scenes.title: 📶 The Communications Tower
scenes.narrative:
The tower ladder rattles violently as the Arctic wind howls around you.

At the top sits a large dish antenna - modified with equipment clearly not part of the original station.

Your radio suddenly crackles.

Then a voice whispers through the static:

"You shouldn't be here."

The signal is being transmitted from below the ice, but the tower is amplifying it.

You notice the amplifier controls glowing.

And something moves far below in the ice field.

choices.text: Climb down quickly and leave the tower.

scenes.title: 📝 The Research Discovery
scenes.narrative:
You power up the research terminal.

Dozens of logs appear — most corrupted.

One file opens.

"Day 47 — We drilled too deep. Something ancient is transmitting through the ice. It reacts to sound… and attention."

Another file appears automatically.

"If anyone finds this: DO NOT AMPLIFY THE SIGNAL."

Suddenly the station lights flicker.

Outside, the ice cracks loudly.

The signal grows stronger.

Something below knows you are here.

choices.text: Shut down all power to the station.
Follow the signal source into the ice elevator.
Panic and run outside onto the ice

scenes.title: ❄️ The Ice Chamber
scenes.narrative:
The elevator descends deep beneath the station.

When the doors open, you enter a massive cavern carved into the ice.

At its center is a black object embedded in the frozen wall, pulsing with dim blue light.

It isn't metal.

It isn't stone.

And it is broadcasting the signal.

The surface ripples slowly — like something breathing.

Your radio turns on by itself.

"Observer detected."

The cavern begins to vibrate.

You realize something terrifying.

The signal wasn't a distress call.

It was a beacon.

scenes.title: ✅ Humanity Saved
scenes.narrative:
You destroy the object.

The cavern collapses as the signal abruptly stops.

Days later, satellites confirm the strange transmissions have vanished worldwide.

Whatever was beneath the ice…

is gone.

Or buried again.

THE END.

scenes.title: 🤐 Silent Victory
scenes.narrative:
You disable the tower amplifier.

Immediately the signal weakens.

Without amplification, whatever lies beneath the ice becomes silent once more.

The world never learns how close it came to awakening.

Some secrets are safer buried.

THE END.

scenes.title: 👽 The First Contact
scenes.narrative:
You speak into the radio.

The object pulses.

Then the cavern fills with light.

Your mind floods with images — stars, worlds, civilizations long gone.

The signal was not a weapon.

It was a message waiting for someone to answer.

And now you have.

Humanity is no longer alone.

But the world will never be the same.

THE END

scenes.title: ☠️ Death.
scenes.narrative:
The ice cracks beneath your feet.

Something massive moves below.

Before you can react, the surface shatters and a black shape erupts from the depths.

Your radio screams with static.

Then silence.

The signal continues broadcasting.

Waiting for the next listener.

YOU DIED
